description:
SortYourTrip is transforming how people plan travel using AI. Our platform generates personalized, customizable travel itineraries in real time and enables users to book flights, hotels, transfers, and activities through a seamless experience. We are building an AI\-native travel platform powered by asynchronous microservices, real\-time updates, and modern LLM technologies.
 



  




 What you'll do
 
 Frontend Development
 


* Build modern, responsive applications using React, TypeScript, and Vite
* Create reusable UI components with Tailwind CSS and modern design systems
* Manage application state using Zustand or similar libraries
* Integrate APIs using TanStack Query
* Build real\-time interfaces using WebSockets
* Develop dashboards for itinerary management and booking workflows
* Optimize performance through lazy loading, memoization, and code splitting
* Ensure cross\-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness



  





 Backend Development
 


* Develop scalable REST APIs using Node.js, Express, and TypeScript
* Design scalable backend architecture and reusable services
* Build asynchronous workflows using BullMQ, Redis, and worker processes
* Integrate third\-party travel APIs for flights, hotels, activities, and transfers
* Design database schemas using MongoDB (Mongoose) or SQL databases
* Implement authentication, authorization, and role\-based access control
* Optimize API performance through caching, indexing, and efficient querying
* Handle logging, monitoring, validation, and error management



  





 AI Engineering
 


* Integrate LLMs including Google Gemini, AWS Bedrock, and OpenAI\-compatible models
* Build AI\-powered travel recommendation systems
* Design prompts and structured outputs for production applications
* Implement tool calling, function calling, and AI workflows
* Build AI agents capable of interacting with internal APIs
* Develop Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using vector databases when applicable
* Evaluate AI outputs and continuously improve quality, reliability, and cost efficiency



  





 Full Stack Integration
 


* Build end\-to\-end features from UI to database
* Design APIs that support scalable frontend architecture
* Connect frontend applications with background workers through WebSockets
* Work closely with designers, product managers, and fellow engineers
* Participate in architecture discussions and code reviews
* Debug production issues and improve system reliability



  





 DevOps \& Cloud
 


* Containerize applications using Docker
* Work with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure
* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps
 
 •
* Deploy and monitor production applications
* Work with CDN, object storage, and cloud networking services



  




 What we're looking for
 
 We value engineers who:
 


* Use AI coding assistants such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or ChatGPT effectively
 
 •
* Understand generated code rather than blindly accepting it
* Write maintainable, testable, and scalable software
* Perform thoughtful code reviews
* Write automated unit and integration tests
* Document APIs and technical decisions
* Take ownership from design through production



  





 Preferred Qualifications
 


* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
* 2\-5 years of professional full\-stack development experience
* Experience building production SaaS or consumer web applications
* Strong problem\-solving skills and product mindset
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced startup environment

description:
**Job Description**
 We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level.
   

  

 As a Software Engineer III at JPMorgan Chase within the Commercial \& Investment Bank Payments Technology team, you will be an experienced member of an agile team, tasked with designing and delivering reliable, market\-leading technology products that are secure, stable, and scalable.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Executes software solutions, design, development, and technical troubleshooting with ability to think beyond routine or conventional approaches to build solutions or breakdown technical problems
* Creates secure and high\-quality production code and maintains algorithms that run synchronously with appropriate systems
* Leverages enterprise\-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity across complex deliverables (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards; contributes learnings and reusable patterns to improve broader team effectiveness.
* Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automation.
* Produces architecture and design artifacts for complex applications while being accountable for ensuring design constraints are met by software code development
* Gathers, analyzes, synthesizes, and develops visualizations and reporting from large, diverse data sets in service of continuous improvement of software applications and systems
* Proactively identifies hidden problems and patterns in data and uses these insights to drive improvements to coding hygiene and system architecture


**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and 3\+ years applied experience
* Hands\-on practical experience in system design, application development, testing, and operational stability
* Full\-stack Java (enterprise): Enterprise application development experience, including building, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment using modern programming languages and database querying languages.
* Java version depth: At least 2 years of hands\-on experience with Java 17\+.
* Agile SDLC delivery: Strong experience delivering through the SDLC using Agile methodologies.
* Cloud\-native AWS delivery: Microservices development and containerization with deployment on AWS EKS and/or ECS (to EC2\), plus Terraform scripting and production AWS deployments; experience with an RDBMS (preferably Oracle or PostgreSQL).
* Hands\-on experience using enterprise\-authorized AI\-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, test creation, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate, validate, and refine AI\-generated outputs for correctness, performance, and security.
* Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations; ability to guide peers on safe and effective usage within team practices.


**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**
* Familiarity with modern front\-end technologies
* Exposure to cloud technologies
* Experience in REACTIVE Java programming, React JS, and Angular frameworks is an added advantage

 At Smart Working, we believe your job should feel right — not just look right on paper. 
 


  


 This isn’t just another remote role. This is belonging remotely — and that’s a big difference. From day one, you're supported, valued, and part of a genuine community. We're proud to be one of the highest\-rated companies on Glassdoor India.
 


  


  
 


  


 With one vision in mind — “Geographical limitations should not dictate access to talent” — Smart Working helps great people build long\-term, full\-time remote careers with exceptional UK teams. We’ve created a culture where you're backed from day one and given the space to grow — personally and professionally.
 


  


  
 


  


**About the Role ( 6 month contract)** 



  


  


 As a Sr. Full Stack Engineer, you will join the growing technology team of an award\-winning UK business specialising in changing and adapting how golf memberships work around the world. Golf is a fast\-growing and hugely popular sport globally, and the business is a leader within its field.
 


  


 This is a senior role focused primarily on backend software development, with responsibility for solving performance and scalability challenges, supporting strategic architecture planning and making technology choices. You will work with cross\-functional teams to define and deliver projects while contributing to technical support and continuous improvement.
 


  


 The company invests significantly in its staff and offers opportunities for promotion, learning and developing new skills.
 


  




  






  




**Responsibilities** 
  

  
* Develop backend software using C\#
  
* Solve technical problems relating to performance and scalability
  
* Work with cross\-functional teams to define and deliver projects
  
* Provide 2nd and 3rd line technical support
  
* Contribute to strategic architecture planning and technology choices
  
* Understand the bigger picture, including identifying opportunities for improvement and understanding user needs
  
* Share your experience and mentor others
  
* Remain open\-minded and willing to learn new skills and technologies
  

  


  


  




**Requirements** 
  

  
* 5\+ years of experience with C\# and .NET 6\.0 Web API
  
* 3\+ years of experience with SQL Server
  
* 1 year of experience with Angular and Next.js
  
* Understanding of Azure
  
* Prior experience with software integrations, including REST and SOAP
  
* Strong communication skills, which are fundamental to this role
  
* Ability to understand the bigger picture, proactively seek opportunities for improvement and understand user needs
  
* Willingness to share experience and mentor others
  
* Open\-mindedness and a desire to learn new skills and technologies
  

  


  


  




**Nice to Have** 
  

  
* Experience with Redis or other NoSQL technologies
  
* Experience with Hangfire or other asynchronous job systems
  
* Experience with Azure or other cloud platforms
  
* Solid architectural experience
  

  


  


  




**Benefits** 
  

  
* Fixed Shifts — 12:00 PM – 9:30 PM IST (Summer) \| 1:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST (Winter)
  
* No Weekend Work — Real work\-life balance, not just words
  
* Day 1 Benefits — Laptop and full medical insurance provided
  
* Support That Matters — Mentorship, community, and forums where ideas are shared
  
* True Belonging — A long\-term home where your contributions are valued
